        ≤ ∑ v ∈ P₁.image (fun p => (p - 1) / Nat.gcd n (p - 1)), (T : ℝ) * (1 / (v : ℝ)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hfibsum
    _ = (T : ℝ) * ∑ v ∈ P₁.image (fun p => (p - 1) / Nat.gcd n (p - 1)), (1 : ℝ) / v := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (T : ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (#(P₁.image (fun p => (p - 1) / Nat.gcd n (p - 1))) + 1),
          (1 : ℝ) / j := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        apply sum_inv_le_sum_Icc
        intro m hm
        obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hp₀v⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
        exact hp₀v ▸ hm2 p₀ hp₀
    _ ≤ (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((#(P₁.image (fun p => (p - 1) / Nat.gcd n (p - 1))) : ℝ) + 1) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        have h := sum_Icc_inv_le_log (#(P₁.image (fun p => (p - 1) / Nat.gcd n (p - 1))) + 1)
        rwa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h
    _ ≤ (T : ℝ) * Real.log n := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        apply Real.log_le_log
        · positivity
        · have h1 : #(P₁.image (fun p => (p - 1) / Nat.gcd n (p - 1))) ≤ #P₁ :=
            Finset.card_image_le
          have h2 : #(P₁.image (fun p => (p - 1) / Nat.gcd n (p - 1))) + 1 ≤ n := by omega
          exact_mod_cast h2
  -- Δ ≤ n²
  have hΔbound : ∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : ∀ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
      intro p hp
      have h2 : #(Ω p) ≤ Nat.gcd n (p - 1) := hdP p hp
      have h3 : Nat.gcd n (p - 1) ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
      exact_mod_cast le_trans h2 h3
    calc ∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ) ≤ ∑ _p ∈ P₁, (n : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum h1
    _ = (#P₁ : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
        exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hrn
    _ = (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
  -- apply the sieve
  obtain ⟨t, ht0, htavoid, htlog⟩ := sieve P₁ hprime₁ Ω hΩsub hhalf
  set k : ℕ := M * t with hkdef
  have hk1 : 0 < k := Nat.mul_pos hM1 ht0
  have hkpow1 : 1 ≤ k ^ n := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hk1
  -- coprimality of k^n - 1 and A
  have hcoprime : Nat.gcd (k ^ n - 1) A = 1 := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨q, hqprime, hqdvd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hne
    have hq1 : q ∣ k ^ n - 1 := hqdvd.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
    have hq2 : q ∣ A := hqdvd.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    have hqPF : q ∈ A.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hqprime, hq2, hA0⟩
    by_cases hqP₀ : (q - 1) ∣ n
    · have hqmem : q ∈ P₀ := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hqPF, hqP₀⟩
      have hqM : q ∣ M := by
        rw [hMdef]
        exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun x => x) hqmem
      have hMk : M ∣ k := by
        rw [hkdef]
        exact dvd_mul_right M t
      have hqk : q ∣ k ^ n := (hqM.trans hMk).trans (dvd_pow_self k hn0)
      have hqone : q ∣ k ^ n - (k ^ n - 1) := Nat.dvd_sub hqk hq1
      rw [Nat.sub_sub_self hkpow1] at hqone
      have h5 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hqone
      have h6 := hqprime.two_le
      omega
    · have hqmem : q ∈ P₁ := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hqPF, hqP₀⟩
      haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime q) := ⟨hqprime⟩
      have hcast : ((k ^ n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 0 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr hq1
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hkpow1] at hcast
      push_cast at hcast
      have hkn1 : (k : ZMod q) ^ n = 1 := by
        have h7 := sub_eq_zero.mp hcast
        exact h7
      have htmod : t % q ∈ Ω q := by
        simp only [hΩdef]
        apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.mod_lt _ hqprime.pos), ?_⟩
        have h5 : ((t % q : ℕ) : ZMod q) = (t : ZMod q) := ZMod.natCast_mod t q
        rw [h5]
        have h6 : (M : ZMod q) * (t : ZMod q) = (k : ZMod q) := by
          rw [hkdef]
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h6]
        exact hkn1
      exact htavoid q hqmem htmod
  -- K n ≤ k
  have hcoprime' : Nat.gcd (k ^ n - 1) (2 ^ n - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← hAdef]
    exact hcoprime
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 2 with hlt | hge
    · exfalso
      have hk1' : k = 1 := by omega
      rw [hk1', one_pow, Nat.sub_self, Nat.gcd_zero_left] at hcoprime
      omega
    · exact hge
  have hKle : K n ≤ k := K_le ⟨hk2, hcoprime'⟩
  -- logarithmic assembly
  have hKpos : (0:ℝ) < (K n : ℝ) := by
    have := two_le_K hn
    have h0 : 0 < K n := by omega
    exact_mod_cast h0
  have hlogK : Real.log (K n) ≤ Real.log k :=
    Real.log_le_log hKpos (by exact_mod_cast hKle)
  have hMR : (0:ℝ) < (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hM1
  have htR : (0:ℝ) < (t : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ht0
  have hlogk : Real.log k = Real.log M + Real.log t := by
    rw [hkdef]
    push_cast
    exact Real.log_mul hMR.ne' htR.ne'
  have hlogn2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
    have hn2 : (4:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 2 := by
      have h : (2:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
      linarith
    have h1 : Real.exp 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) + 2 := by
      have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      linarith
    have h2 := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) h1
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at h2
  have hlogM : Real.log M ≤ (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
    have h1 : Real.log M ≤ Real.log (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ T) := Real.log_le_log hMR hMle
    rw [Real.log_pow] at h1
    have h2 : Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by linarith)
    calc Real.log M ≤ (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) := h1
    _ ≤ (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
  -- convert the sieve bound
  have hnR2 : (2:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hσ1 : (∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ) / p) + 1 ≤ 2 * (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
    have h1 : Real.log n ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h2 : (T : ℝ) * Real.log n ≤ (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
    have hT1R : (1:ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT1
    have h3 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by nlinarith
    linarith [hσbound]
  have hsumΩ0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hΔ2 : Real.log ((∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ)) + 2) ≤ 2 * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
    have h1 : (∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ)) + 2 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [hΔbound]
    calc Real.log ((∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ)) + 2)
        ≤ Real.log (((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2) := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h1
    _ = 2 * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
        rw [Real.log_pow]
        push_cast
        ring
  have hσnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ ∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ) / p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun p hp => by positivity
  have hlogΔnn : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ)) + 2) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hlogt2 : Real.log t ≤ 400 * (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 := by
    have hb1 : 100 * ((∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ) / p) + 1)
        ≤ 100 * (2 * (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2)) := by linarith
    have hb0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 100 * ((∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ) / p) + 1) := by linarith
    calc Real.log t
        ≤ 100 * ((∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ) / p) + 1)
          * Real.log ((∑ p ∈ P₁, (#(Ω p) : ℝ)) + 2) := htlog
    _ ≤ 100 * (2 * (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2)) * (2 * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul hb1 hΔ2 hlogΔnn
        have hT0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg T
        nlinarith
    _ = 400 * (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 := by ring
  calc Real.log (K n) ≤ Real.log k := hlogK
  _ = Real.log M + Real.log t := hlogk
  _ ≤ (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) + 400 * (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 := by
      linarith
  _ ≤ 500 * (T : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 := by
      have hT0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg T
      nlinarith [hlogn2]

/-- The bound for `H`: `log H(n) ≤ 500 τ(n) (log (n+2))²`. -/
theorem log_H_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Real.log (H n) ≤ 500 * (#n.divisors : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2 := by
  have h1 : Real.log (H n) ≤ Real.log (K n) := by
    apply Real.log_le_log
    · have := three_le_H hn
      have h0 : 0 < H n := by omega
      exact_mod_cast h0
    · exact_mod_cast H_le_K hn
  exact h1.trans (log_K_le hn)


/-! ## From Erdos820/Wigert.lean -/

/-
Wigert's upper bound for the divisor function (Lemma 3.2 of the paper):

  for every `η > 0`, eventually  `log τ(n) ≤ (log 2 + η) · log n / log log n`.

The proof follows the paper: with `δ = c₀ / log log n` (where `c₀ = log 2 + η/2`),
split the prime factorization of `n` at `p^δ ≥ 2`.  Large primes contribute at
most `n^δ`; each small prime contributes a factor at most `(1 - 2^{-δ})⁻¹`, and
there are at most `2^{1/δ}` small primes.
-/


open Finset Filter

/-- Pointwise Wigert-type bound: for `0 < δ`,
`τ(n) ≤ n^δ · ((1 - 2^{-δ})⁻¹)^⌊2^{1/δ}⌋`. -/
lemma tau_le_rpow (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) :
    (#n.divisors : ℝ)
      ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ δ * ((1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹) ^ ⌊(2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ)⌋₊ := by
  -- basic facts about `2^{-δ}`
  have h2δpos : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have h2δlt1 : (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) < 1 :=
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hcpos : (0:ℝ) < (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ := by
    apply inv_pos.mpr
    linarith
  have hc1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ := by
    rw [one_le_inv_iff₀]
    constructor
    · linarith
    · linarith
  -- factorization data
  have hτ : (#n.divisors : ℝ)
      = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, ((n.factorization p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.card_divisors hn]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hnfact : (n : ℝ) = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, ((p : ℝ) ^ (n.factorization p)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self hn]
    rw [Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hrpow : (n : ℝ) ^ δ
      = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, ((p : ℝ) ^ (n.factorization p)) ^ δ := by
    rw [hnfact, ← Real.finset_prod_rpow _ _ (fun p _ => by positivity) δ]
  -- the per-prime factor bound
  have hfac : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, ((n.factorization p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ ((p : ℝ) ^ (n.factorization p)) ^ δ
        * (if (p:ℝ) ^ δ < 2 then (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ else 1) := by
    intro p hp
    have hpprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hp2 : 2 ≤ p := hpprime.two_le
    have hp0 : (0:ℝ) < (p:ℝ) := by
      have := hpprime.pos
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hcomm : ((p:ℝ) ^ (n.factorization p)) ^ δ = ((p:ℝ) ^ δ) ^ (n.factorization p) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (p:ℝ) (n.factorization p), ← Real.rpow_mul hp0.le,
        mul_comm, Real.rpow_mul hp0.le, Real.rpow_natCast]
    have hpδpos : (0:ℝ) < (p:ℝ) ^ δ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hp0 δ
    by_cases hcase : (p:ℝ) ^ δ < 2
    · rw [if_pos hcase, hcomm]
      -- small prime: geometric series argument
      have hpδ1 : (1:ℝ) < (p:ℝ) ^ δ := by
        have h2p : (2:ℝ) ≤ (p:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp2
        calc (1:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ δ := by
              apply Real.one_lt_rpow_iff_of_pos (by norm_num) |>.mpr
              exact Or.inl ⟨by norm_num, hδ0⟩
        _ ≤ (p:ℝ) ^ δ := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by norm_num) h2p hδ0.le
      have hx0 : (0:ℝ) < ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹ := by positivity
      have hx1 : ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hpδ1
      -- (a+1)·x^a ≤ (1-x)⁻¹ where x = (p^δ)⁻¹, a = factorization
      have hgeom : ((n.factorization p : ℝ) + 1) * (((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) ^ (n.factorization p)
          ≤ (1 - ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹)⁻¹ := by
        have h1 : ((n.factorization p : ℝ) + 1) * (((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) ^ (n.factorization p)
            = ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range (n.factorization p + 1),
                (((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) ^ (n.factorization p) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
          push_cast
          ring
        have h2 : ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range (n.factorization p + 1),
              (((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) ^ (n.factorization p)
            ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n.factorization p + 1), (((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) ^ j := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j hj
          exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one hx0.le hx1.le
            (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj))
        have h3 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n.factorization p + 1), (((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) ^ j
            ≤ (1 - ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹)⁻¹ := by
          rw [geom_sum_eq (by linarith : ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹ ≠ 1)]
          have h4 : ((((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) ^ (n.factorization p + 1) - 1) / (((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹ - 1)
              = (1 - (((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) ^ (n.factorization p + 1)) / (1 - ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) := by
            rw [← neg_sub (1:ℝ) ((((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹) ^ (n.factorization p + 1)),
              ← neg_sub (1:ℝ) (((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹), neg_div_neg_eq]
          have hden : (0:ℝ) < 1 - ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹ := by linarith
          rw [h4, inv_eq_one_div (1 - ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹), div_le_div_iff₀ hden hden]
          nlinarith [pow_nonneg hx0.le (n.factorization p + 1)]
        linarith
      -- pass from `(1-x)⁻¹` to `(1-2^{-δ})⁻¹`
      have hxle : ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹ ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
        have h2δp : (2:ℝ) ^ δ ≤ (p:ℝ) ^ δ :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hp2) hδ0.le
        have h2δ0 : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ δ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) δ
        rw [inv_eq_one_div ((p:ℝ) ^ δ), inv_eq_one_div ((2:ℝ) ^ δ)]
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le h2δ0 h2δp
      have hinvle : (1 - ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹)⁻¹ ≤ (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ := by
        rw [inv_eq_one_div (1 - ((p:ℝ) ^ δ)⁻¹), inv_eq_one_div (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))]
        apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le
        · linarith
        · linarith
      -- assemble
      have h5 : ((n.factorization p : ℝ) + 1) * ((((p:ℝ) ^ δ) ^ (n.factorization p))⁻¹)
          ≤ (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ := by
        rw [← inv_pow]
        exact hgeom.trans hinvle
      have hppow : (0:ℝ) < ((p:ℝ) ^ δ) ^ (n.factorization p) := by positivity
      have hcast : ((n.factorization p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n.factorization p : ℝ) + 1 := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hcast]
      calc (n.factorization p : ℝ) + 1
          = ((n.factorization p : ℝ) + 1) * ((((p:ℝ) ^ δ) ^ (n.factorization p))⁻¹)
            * ((p:ℝ) ^ δ) ^ (n.factorization p) := by
            field_simp
      _ ≤ (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ * ((p:ℝ) ^ δ) ^ (n.factorization p) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5 hppow.le
      _ = ((p:ℝ) ^ δ) ^ (n.factorization p) * (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ := by ring
    · rw [if_neg hcase, mul_one, hcomm]
      push_neg at hcase
      have h2a : ((n.factorization p : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (n.factorization p) := by
        have h := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := n.factorization p)
        have h' : n.factorization p + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (n.factorization p) := h
        exact_mod_cast h'
      have h2pa : (2:ℝ) ^ (n.factorization p) ≤ ((p:ℝ) ^ δ) ^ (n.factorization p) :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hcase _
      push_cast
      push_cast at h2a
      linarith
  -- multiply the factor bounds
  have hprodle : (#n.divisors : ℝ)
      ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ δ * ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors,
          (if (p:ℝ) ^ δ < 2 then (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ else 1) := by
    rw [hτ, hrpow, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun p _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _) hfac
  -- the conditional product is a power of the constant
  have hite : ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors,
        (if (p:ℝ) ^ δ < 2 then (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ else 1)
      = ((1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹)
          ^ #(n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p:ℝ) ^ δ < 2)) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_ite, Finset.prod_const, Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one]
  -- count of small primes
  have hsmall : #(n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p:ℝ) ^ δ < 2))
      ≤ ⌊(2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ)⌋₊ := by
    have hsub : n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p:ℝ) ^ δ < 2)
        ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊(2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ)⌋₊ := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hp
      have hpprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp.1
      have hp0 : (0:ℝ) < (p:ℝ) := by
        have := hpprime.pos
        exact_mod_cast this
      have hple : (p:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) := by
        have h1 : ((p:ℝ) ^ δ) ^ (1/δ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hp.2.le (by positivity)
        rwa [← Real.rpow_mul hp0.le, mul_one_div, div_self hδ0.ne',
          Real.rpow_one] at h1
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨hpprime.one_lt.le, Nat.le_floor hple⟩
    calc #(n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p:ℝ) ^ δ < 2))
        ≤ #(Finset.Icc 1 ⌊(2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ)⌋₊) := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = ⌊(2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ)⌋₊ := by
        rw [Nat.card_Icc]
        omega
  calc (#n.divisors : ℝ)
      ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ δ * ((1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹)
          ^ #(n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p:ℝ) ^ δ < 2)) := by
        rw [← hite]
        exact hprodle
  _ ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ δ * ((1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹) ^ ⌊(2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ)⌋₊ := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
        exact pow_le_pow_right₀ hc1 hsmall

/-- Logarithmic form of the pointwise bound: for `0 < δ ≤ 1`,
`log τ(n) ≤ δ log n + 2^{1/δ} (log 4 - log δ)`. -/
lemma log_tau_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    Real.log (#n.divisors)
      ≤ δ * Real.log n + (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) * (Real.log 4 - Real.log δ) := by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hτ1 : 1 ≤ #n.divisors :=
    Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨1, Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨one_dvd n, hn0⟩⟩
  have hτpos : (0:ℝ) < (#n.divisors : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hτ1
  -- constants
  have h2δpos : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have h2δlt1 : (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) < 1 :=
    Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hgap : δ / 4 ≤ 1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) := by
    -- 1 - 2^{-δ} ≥ δ·log 2·2^{-δ} ≥ δ/4
    have hlog2 : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
      linarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
    have h2δhalf : (1/2:ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) := by
      have h1 : (2:ℝ) ^ δ ≤ 2 := by
        have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2) hδ1
        rwa [Real.rpow_one] at h
      have h2 : (0:ℝ) < (2:ℝ) ^ δ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) δ
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), inv_eq_one_div]
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le h2 h1
    have hkey : δ * Real.log 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) ≤ 1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) := by
      -- with u = δ log 2:  u e^{-u} ≤ 1 - e^{-u}  ⟺  1 + u ≤ e^u
      have hu : (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) = Real.exp (-(δ * Real.log 2)) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
        congr 1
        ring
      have hexp : δ * Real.log 2 + 1 ≤ Real.exp (δ * Real.log 2) :=
        Real.add_one_le_exp _
      have hepos : (0:ℝ) < Real.exp (-(δ * Real.log 2)) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hprod : Real.exp (δ * Real.log 2) * Real.exp (-(δ * Real.log 2)) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        norm_num
      rw [hu]
      nlinarith
    have hstep1 : δ / 2 ≤ δ * Real.log 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hδ0.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 - 1/2)]
    have hlognn : (0:ℝ) ≤ δ * Real.log 2 := by nlinarith
    have hstep2 : (δ / 2) * (1/2) ≤ (δ * Real.log 2) * (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ) :=
      mul_le_mul hstep1 h2δhalf (by norm_num) hlognn
    nlinarith [hkey, hstep2]
  have hgappos : (0:ℝ) < δ / 4 := by linarith
  have hinvle : (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ ≤ 4 / δ := by
    have h1 : (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ ≤ (δ/4)⁻¹ := by
      rw [inv_eq_one_div, inv_eq_one_div]
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hgappos hgap
    have h2 : ((δ:ℝ)/4)⁻¹ = 4/δ := by
      rw [inv_div]
    linarith
  have hcpos : (0:ℝ) < (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ := by
    apply inv_pos.mpr
    linarith
  have hc1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹ := by
    rw [one_le_inv_iff₀]
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  -- take logs in `tau_le_rpow`
  have hmain := tau_le_rpow n hn0 hδ0
  have hnpos : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by
    have : 0 < n := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hτpos hmain
  rw [Real.log_mul (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hnpos δ).ne' (pow_pos hcpos _).ne',
    Real.log_rpow hnpos, Real.log_pow] at hlog
  -- bound the error term
  have hfloor : (⌊(2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) :=
    Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hlogc : Real.log ((1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹) ≤ Real.log 4 - Real.log δ := by
    have h1 : Real.log ((1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹) ≤ Real.log (4/δ) :=
      Real.log_le_log hcpos hinvle
    rwa [Real.log_div (by norm_num) hδ0.ne'] at h1
  have hlogcpos : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹) :=
    Real.log_nonneg hc1
  have herr : (⌊(2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ)⌋₊ : ℝ) * Real.log ((1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-δ))⁻¹)
      ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) * (Real.log 4 - Real.log δ) := by
    apply mul_le_mul hfloor hlogc hlogcpos (by positivity)
  linarith

/-- **Wigert's theorem** (upper-bound half): for every `η > 0`, eventually in `n`,
`log τ(n) ≤ (log 2 + η) · log n / log log n`. -/
theorem log_card_divisors_le {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      Real.log (#n.divisors)
        ≤ (Real.log 2 + η) * (Real.log n / Real.log (Real.log n)) := by
  have hlog2 : (0:ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀def⟩ : ∃ c₀ : ℝ, c₀ = Real.log 2 + η / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc₀ : 0 < c₀ := by rw [hc₀def]; linarith
  obtain ⟨β, hβdef⟩ : ∃ β : ℝ, β = Real.log 2 / c₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hβ0 : 0 < β := by rw [hβdef]; positivity
  have hβlt : β < 1 := by
    rw [hβdef, div_lt_one hc₀, hc₀def]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨ε, hεdef⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, ε = (1 - β) / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε0 : 0 < ε := by rw [hεdef]; linarith
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂def⟩ : ∃ C₂ : ℝ, C₂ = |Real.log 4 - Real.log c₀| + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC₂1 : 1 ≤ C₂ := by
    rw [hC₂def]
    linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log 4 - Real.log c₀)]
  obtain ⟨C₃, hC₃def⟩ : ∃ C₃ : ℝ, C₃ = 2 * C₂ / (η * ε ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC₃0 : 0 < C₃ := by
    rw [hC₃def]
    positivity
  -- limit facts
  have hlogtends : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hloglog : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (Real.log n))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hlogtends
  have hrpowt : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (Real.log n) ^ ((1 - β)/2 : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < (1 - β)/2)).comp hlogtends
  filter_upwards [hloglog.eventually_ge_atTop (max c₀ 1),
    hlogtends.eventually_ge_atTop 1,
    hrpowt.eventually_ge_atTop C₃,
    Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with n hy hℓ hC₃n hn2
  -- abbreviations
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓdef⟩ : ∃ ℓ : ℝ, ℓ = Real.log n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hydef⟩ : ∃ y : ℝ, y = Real.log (Real.log n) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hℓdef] at hℓ hC₃n
  rw [← hydef] at hy
  have hyℓ : y = Real.log ℓ := by rw [hydef, hℓdef]
  rw [← hydef, ← hℓdef]
  have hℓpos : (0:ℝ) < ℓ := by linarith
  have hy1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ y := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hy
  have hyc₀ : c₀ ≤ y := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hy
  have hypos : (0:ℝ) < y := by linarith
  -- the choice of δ
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = c₀ / y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by rw [hδdef]; positivity
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hδdef, div_le_one hypos]
    exact hyc₀
  -- apply the pointwise bound
  have hmain := log_tau_le n hn2 hδ0 hδ1
  rw [← hℓdef] at hmain
  -- identify `2^{1/δ}` with `ℓ^β`
  have h2δ : (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) = ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2),
      Real.rpow_def_of_pos hℓpos, ← hyℓ, hδdef, hβdef]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    try ring
  -- bound the error factor
  have hlogδ : Real.log δ = Real.log c₀ - Real.log y := by
    rw [hδdef, Real.log_div hc₀.ne' hypos.ne']
  have hlogy : Real.log y ≤ y := by
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hypos]
  have herrfac : Real.log 4 - Real.log δ ≤ C₂ * y := by
    rw [hlogδ]
    have h1 : Real.log 4 - Real.log c₀ ≤ |Real.log 4 - Real.log c₀| := le_abs_self _
    have h2 : |Real.log 4 - Real.log c₀| * 1 ≤ |Real.log 4 - Real.log c₀| * y :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy1 (abs_nonneg _)
    rw [hC₂def]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log 4 - Real.log c₀)]
  have hℓβpos : (0:ℝ) < ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hℓpos _
  have herr : (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) * (Real.log 4 - Real.log δ) ≤ ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * (C₂ * y) := by
    rw [h2δ]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left herrfac hℓβpos.le
  -- `y ≤ ℓ^ε/ε`
  have hyε : y ≤ ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ) / ε := by
    rw [hyℓ]
    exact Real.log_le_rpow_div hℓpos.le hε0
  have hℓεpos : (0:ℝ) < ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hℓpos _
  -- final numeric comparison: error * y ≤ (η/2) ℓ
  have hkey : ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * (C₂ * y) * y ≤ (η/2) * ℓ := by
    have hℓC₂ : (0:ℝ) ≤ ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ := mul_nonneg hℓβpos.le (by linarith)
    have h1 : ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * (C₂ * y) * y ≤ ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) := by
      have hb1 : ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * y * y ≤ ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) * y := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hypos.le
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyε hℓC₂
      have hb2 : ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) * y
          ≤ ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyε
        apply mul_nonneg hℓC₂
        positivity
      calc ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * (C₂ * y) * y = ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * y * y := by ring
      _ ≤ ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) * y := hb1
      _ ≤ ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) := hb2
    have h2 : ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε)
        = (C₂/ε^2) * (ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ) * ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)) := by
      field_simp
      try ring
    have h3 : ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ) * ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ) = ℓ ^ (β + ε + ε : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hℓpos, ← Real.rpow_add hℓpos]
    have h4 : ℓ ^ (β + ε + ε : ℝ) * ℓ ^ ((1 - β)/2 : ℝ) = ℓ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hℓpos]
      have harith : β + ε + ε + (1 - β)/2 = 1 := by
        rw [hεdef]
        ring
      rw [harith, Real.rpow_one]
    have h5 : (C₂/ε^2) * ℓ ^ (β + ε + ε : ℝ) ≤ (η/2) * ℓ := by
      have hpow : (0:ℝ) < ℓ ^ (β + ε + ε : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hℓpos _
      have hC₃eq : (η/2) * C₃ = C₂/ε^2 := by
        rw [hC₃def]
        field_simp
        try ring
      have h7 : C₂/ε^2 ≤ (η/2) * ℓ ^ ((1 - β)/2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← hC₃eq]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC₃n (by linarith)
      calc (C₂/ε^2) * ℓ ^ (β + ε + ε : ℝ)
          ≤ ((η/2) * ℓ ^ ((1 - β)/2 : ℝ)) * ℓ ^ (β + ε + ε : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h7 hpow.le
      _ = (η/2) * (ℓ ^ (β + ε + ε : ℝ) * ℓ ^ ((1 - β)/2 : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ = (η/2) * ℓ := by rw [h4]
    calc ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * (C₂ * y) * y
        ≤ ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * C₂ * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) * (ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)/ε) := h1
    _ = (C₂/ε^2) * (ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ) * ℓ ^ (ε:ℝ)) := h2
    _ = (C₂/ε^2) * ℓ ^ (β + ε + ε : ℝ) := by rw [h3]
    _ ≤ (η/2) * ℓ := h5
  -- error ≤ (η/2)·(ℓ/y)
  have herrfinal : (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) * (Real.log 4 - Real.log δ) ≤ (η/2) * (ℓ/y) := by
    have h1 : ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * (C₂ * y) ≤ (η/2) * ℓ / y := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hypos]
      exact hkey
    calc (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) * (Real.log 4 - Real.log δ) ≤ ℓ ^ (β:ℝ) * (C₂ * y) := herr
    _ ≤ (η/2) * ℓ / y := h1
    _ = (η/2) * (ℓ/y) := by ring
  -- main term
  have hmainterm : δ * ℓ = c₀ * (ℓ/y) := by
    rw [hδdef]
    field_simp
  calc Real.log (#n.divisors)
      ≤ δ * ℓ + (2:ℝ) ^ (1/δ) * (Real.log 4 - Real.log δ) := hmain
  _ ≤ c₀ * (ℓ/y) + (η/2) * (ℓ/y) := by
      rw [← hmainterm]
      linarith [herrfinal]
  _ = (c₀ + η/2) * (ℓ/y) := by ring
  _ = (Real.log 2 + η) * (ℓ/y) := by
      rw [hc₀def]
      ring


/-! ## From Erdos820/Corollary.lean -/

/-
Corollary 1.2 of the paper.  Combining the main theorem with Wigert's bound:

* `log log K(n) ≤ (log 2 + ε) · log n / log log n`  eventually, for every `ε > 0`;
* consequently `H(n) ≤ K(n) < exp (n^{(log 2 + ε)/log log n})` eventually.
-/


open Filter Finset

/-- First half of Corollary 1.2:
`log log K(n) ≤ (log 2 + ε) log n / log log n` eventually. -/
theorem loglog_K_le {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log (Real.log (K n))
        ≤ (Real.log 2 + ε) * (Real.log n / Real.log (Real.log n)) := by
  have hlogtends : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hloglog : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (Real.log n))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hlogtends
  have hrpowt : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (Real.log n) ^ ((1:ℝ)/2))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/2)).comp hlogtends
  filter_upwards [log_card_divisors_le (half_pos hε),
    hloglog.eventually_ge_atTop 1,
    hlogtends.eventually_ge_atTop 1,
    hrpowt.eventually_ge_atTop (16128 / ε),
    Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with n hτ hy hℓ hsqrt hn2
  -- abbreviations
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓdef⟩ : ∃ ℓ : ℝ, ℓ = Real.log n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hydef⟩ : ∃ y : ℝ, y = Real.log (Real.log n) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hℓdef] at hℓ hsqrt
  rw [← hydef] at hy
  rw [← hydef, ← hℓdef] at hτ ⊢
  have hyℓ : y = Real.log ℓ := by rw [hydef, hℓdef]
  have hℓpos : (0:ℝ) < ℓ := by linarith
  have hypos : (0:ℝ) < y := by linarith
  -- positivity facts about K n
  have hK3 : 3 ≤ K n := three_le_K hn2
  have hKR : (3:ℝ) ≤ (K n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK3
  have hlogK1 : (1:ℝ) < Real.log (K n) := by
    have h1 : (1:ℝ) < Real.log 3 := by
      rw [Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 3)]
      linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
    have h2 : Real.log 3 ≤ Real.log (K n) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hKR
    linarith
  have hlogKpos : (0:ℝ) < Real.log (K n) := by linarith
  -- log(n+2) ≥ 1
  have hlogn2 : (1:ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
    have hn2R : (2:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn2
    have h1 : Real.exp 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) + 2 := by
      linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
    have h2 := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) h1
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at h2
  have hlogn2pos : (0:ℝ) < Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by linarith
  -- τ ≥ 1
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hτ1 : 1 ≤ #n.divisors :=
    Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨1, Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨one_dvd n, hn0⟩⟩
  have hτpos : (0:ℝ) < (#n.divisors : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hτ1
  -- take logs in the main theorem
  have hmain := log_K_le hn2
  have hloglogK : Real.log (Real.log (K n))
      ≤ Real.log 500 + Real.log (#n.divisors) + 2 * Real.log (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2)) := by
    have h1 := Real.log_le_log hlogKpos hmain
    have h2 : Real.log (500 * (#n.divisors : ℝ) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2)
        = Real.log 500 + Real.log (#n.divisors)
          + 2 * Real.log (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2)) := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 500 * (#n.divisors : ℝ)).ne'
          (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) ^ 2).ne',
        Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (500:ℝ) ≠ 0) hτpos.ne',
        Real.log_pow]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [← h2]
    exact h1
  -- bound log log (n+2) by log 2 + y
  have hloglogn2 : Real.log (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2)) ≤ Real.log 2 + y := by
    have hn2R : (2:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn2
    have h1 : (n : ℝ) + 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h2 : Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≤ 2 * ℓ := by
      have h3 := Real.log_le_log (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 2) h1
      rw [Real.log_pow] at h3
      rw [hℓdef]
      push_cast at h3
      linarith
    have h4 : Real.log (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 2)) ≤ Real.log (2 * ℓ) :=
      Real.log_le_log hlogn2pos h2
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) ≠ 0) hℓpos.ne', ← hyℓ] at h4
    exact h4
  -- numeric error bound: log 500 + 2 log 2 + 2 y ≤ (ε/2) (ℓ/y)
  have herror : Real.log 500 + 2 * Real.log 2 + 2 * y ≤ (ε/2) * (ℓ/y) := by
    have h500 : Real.log 500 ≤ 499 := by
